meta.name: bili-digest
meta.description: Summarize and organize the user's own logged-in Bilibili Watch Later and Favorites lists for local agent notes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理B站稍后再看和收藏列表为本地笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在B站收藏视频但从未整理过
copy.tagline_en: Organize Bilibili watch later and favorites into local notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often save Bilibili videos but never organize them

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以总结、整理你已登录的 Bilibili 稍后再看和收藏夹列表，并生成本地笔记。
howto.when: 当你要求总结、查看或整理 Bilibili 稍后再看、收藏夹或某个具体视频时触发。

say.text: 总结我 Bilibili 稍后再看列表的前 15 个视频。
say.note: Claude 会获取列表并生成摘要。

say.text: 帮我整理收藏夹里最近收藏的视频。
say.note: Claude 会读取收藏夹并组织笔记。

say.text: 提取这个 Bilibili 视频的字幕并总结。
say.note: Claude 会获取字幕并生成总结。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can summarize and organize your logged-in Bilibili Watch Later and Favorites lists, and generate local notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to summarize, inspect, or take notes from Bilibili Watch Later, Favorites, or a specific video.

say_en.text: Summarize my Bilibili Watch Later list, first 15 videos.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the list and generates a summary.
Claude reads the favorites and organizes notes.

say_en.text: Extract subtitles from this Bilibili video and summarize.
say_en.note: Claude gets subtitles and generates a summary.
